label: ESTIMATE
description: Assumed analyst minutes for investigating an exception manually versus with the workbench. These are planning estimates for discussion, NOT measurements. Replace them with timed observations when available.
assumptions: Manual: the analyst works across separate systems (origination, servicing, mapping configuration, document store, past-case log) with no pre-assembled evidence.
AI-assisted: the model runs unattended; analyst time is reviewing the report and evidence in the workbench, plus recording the resolution.
Steps whose evidence is not held by the platform (e.g. servicing static data, interface logs) remain manual in both modes.
Review time assumes the report is usable; when it is wrong, review takes longer (see the sensitivity factor).
